description: Radxa Cubie A7A (Allwinner A733: 2 Cortex-A76 and 6 Cortex-A55), 4 GB LPDDR5 (UNCONFIRMED on the page). A board record: Atlas flashes it from the A733's FEL download mode, an eGON SPL and U-Boot over USB, and writes the microSD card. The family (allwinner-fel) gives the shared download-mode method and steps. Written from Radxa's docs and the board schematic; untested on this board.

ram.this_record: 4 GB LPDDR5 (UNCONFIRMED: not on the page's option list as this size)

network.ethernet: 1x Gigabit through the MAE0621A-Q3C PHY (schematic p18); PoE through a HAT
network.wifi_bt: Wi-Fi 6 and Bluetooth 5.4 (module FCU760K, schematic p13)

ports: USB-C: power and OTG (USB0), the only USB-C
PCIe 3.0 x1 on an FPC connector
8 MB SPI NOR boot flash (not written by Atlas)

fan.connector: UNCONFIRMED: the overview says a 2-pin 1.25 mm header, the schematic p19 connector carries 3 signals

camera.connectors: one 31-pin FPC (CAM_31P), 4 data lanes and a clock

storage_target_evidence: docs.radxa.com Cubie A7A: a microSD (TF) slot is fitted; an eMMC or UFS module comes on a combo connector and is not fitted by default; an 8 MB SPI NOR holds the boot flash.
Atlas writes the microSD card (the SD target) and does not write the SPI NOR.
instructions: Hold the UBOOT key (SW2) before power-on, and connect the board's USB-C port to this computer with a USB-A to USB-C data cable.
Power the board on, then release the UBOOT key.
The board appears as 1f3a:efe8 (Allwinner FEL). Atlas loads the SPL and U-Boot over FEL, writes the image to the microSD card, reads it back and restarts the board.

flash.fel_image: eGON SPL then legacy U-Boot (u-boot-sunxi-with-spl form), UNCONFIRMED for the A733

todo: Sources: the FEL steps are from docs.radxa.com/en/cubie/a7a/low-level-dev/install-system/fel-install-system/fel-mode (the UBOOT key SW2 and the cable). The 1f3a:efe8 id is in Radxa's PhoenixSuit driver docs (VID_1f3a PID_efe8) and sunxi-tools' fel_lib.h (0xEFE8). UNCONFIRMED until lsusb on the board shows it in FEL mode.

UNCONFIRMED: the loader glob u-boot-sunxi-with-spl*.bin. Radxa's FEL images are Android 13 zips from github.com/radxa/allwinner-android-manifests (the A7Z's is a733_android13_radxa_a7z_20250917_uart0.zip); the A7A's zip is not downloaded and its SPL and U-Boot files are not inspected. Gaia needs: the A733 FEL image (eGON SPL and U-Boot) as the loader, and the microSD disk image (whole disk, image_offset 0).
UNCONFIRMED: the 4 GB RAM size (the page lists 2, 4, 6, 8, 12 and 16 GB without saying which the 4 GB board is).
UNCONFIRMED: the fan connector (2-pin 1.25 mm per the overview, 3 signals per schematic p19).
UNCONFIRMED: the A733's SRAM layout for the FEL thunk (the family's sram is null until the record or family gives one).
The SPI NOR (8 MB) is not written by Atlas; the eMMC or UFS module is not fitted by default, so the microSD is the storage target.
Running, the board needs a Gaia image with board-lite before Atlas can see it; no Gaia board config for the Cubie exists yet.
